results.question: Kaç müşteri var?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers

results.question: Enterprise segmentindeki müşterileri listele
results.sql:
SELECT customer_id, customer_name, country, segment, created_at
FROM customers
WHERE segment = 'Enterprise'
LIMIT 50

results.question: Almanya'daki müşteri sayısı
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers
WHERE country = 'Almanya'

results.question: Ürün kategorilerine göre ürün sayısı
results.sql:
SELECT
  p.category,
  COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count
FROM
  products p
GROUP BY
  p.category
ORDER BY
  product_count DESC
LIMIT 50

results.question: En pahalı ürün hangisi?
results.sql:
SELECT 
  product_name, 
  unit_price 
FROM products 
ORDER BY unit_price DESC 
LIMIT 1

results.question: SKU-100 ürününün adı nedir?
results.sql:
SELECT p.product_name
FROM products p
WHERE p.sku = 'SKU-100'
LIMIT 50

results.question: Completed sipariş sayısı
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count
FROM sales_orders
WHERE status = 'Completed'

results.question: 2026 yılı siparişlerini getir
results.sql: SELECT * FROM sales_orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026 LIMIT 50

results.question: Pending siparişleri olan müşteriler
results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.customer_name
FROM customers c
JOIN sales_orders so ON c.customer_id = so.customer_id
WHERE so.status = 'pending'
LIMIT 50

results.question: Her siparişin toplam tutarı (order_items)
results.sql:
SELECT
  soi.order_id,
  SUM(soi.quantity * soi.unit_price) AS total_amount
FROM sales_order_items soi
GROUP BY soi.order_id
LIMIT 50

results.question: En çok satılan ürün (adet)
results.sql:
SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM sales_order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN sales_orders so ON oi.order_id = so.order_id
WHERE so.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC
LIMIT 50

results.question: Segment bazında toplam gelir
results.sql:
SELECT
    c.segment,
    SUM(soi.quantity * soi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN sales_orders so ON c.customer_id = so.customer_id
JOIN sales_order_items soi ON so.order_id = soi.order_id
WHERE so.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 50

results.question: v_order_revenue üzerinden ülke bazında ciro
results.sql:
WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total_revenue
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    c.country,
    SUM(orv.total_revenue) AS total_country_revenue
FROM order_revenue orv
JOIN customers c ON orv.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_country_revenue DESC
LIMIT 50

results.question: Acme Holding'in sipariş sayısı
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM sales_orders so
JOIN customers c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_name = 'Acme Holding'

results.question: Services kategorisindeki ürünler
results.sql:
SELECT 
  p.product_id,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  p.category,
  p.unit_price
FROM products p
WHERE p.category = 'Services'
LIMIT 50

results.question: İptal edilen siparişler
results.sql:
SELECT
    so.order_id,
    so.customer_id,
    so.order_date,
    so.currency,
    so.status
FROM
    sales_orders so
WHERE
    so.status = 'cancelled'
LIMIT 50

results.question: 2026 yılındaki toplam fatura tutarı
results.sql:
SELECT SUM(gross_amount) AS total_invoice_amount
FROM invoices
WHERE invoice_date >= '2026-01-01'
  AND invoice_date < '2027-01-01'

results.question: Ödenmemiş faturaların kalan tutarı
results.sql:
SELECT SUM(remaining_amount) AS total_unpaid_amount
FROM invoices
WHERE status = 'unpaid'

results.question: Ankara'daki müşterilere ait gecikmiş faturalar
results.sql:
WITH delayed_invoices AS (
    SELECT
        i.invoice_id,
        i.order_id,
        i.invoice_date,
        i.due_date,
        i.gross_amount,
        i.remaining_amount,
        i.status,
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        ca.city
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN sales_orders so ON i.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN customer_addresses ca ON c.customer_id = ca.customer_id
    WHERE ca.city = 'Ankara'
      AND ca.is_primary = true
      AND i.status IN ('pending', 'overdue')
      AND i.remaining_amount > 0
      AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
)
SELECT
    invoice_id,
    customer_name,
    invoice_date,
    due_date,
    gross_amount,
    remaining_amount,
    status
FROM delayed_invoices
ORDER BY due_date ASC
LIMIT 50

results.question: İptal edilmiş faturaları hariç tutarak toplam tutar
results.sql:
SELECT SUM(i.gross_amount) AS total_amount
FROM invoices i
WHERE i.status != 'cancelled'
